svg.title: The gold tables in a warehouse, modelled with dbt
svg.desc: load_gold.py loads items, price points and purchase lines into DuckDB or Snowflake. dbt builds staging views and two marts: the weekly benchmark and the savings opportunity. 28 checks pass and all 681 weekly snapshots match the Python build.
svg.text: same SQL on DuckDB (laptop) and Snowflake (cloud)
what dbt checks on every build
19 data tests: keys, links, order, one row per week
exact decimal percentiles, halves round up
the Python build behind the demo,
free locally with DuckDB. on a Snowflake trial: an X-Small warehouse that suspends after 60s.
